items.desc_en: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.
items.desc_zh: 目前尚不清楚谁是这些袭击的幕后黑手。作为对乌克兰战争的一部分，俄罗斯加强了在黑海的袭击。

items.title_en: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
items.title_zh: 太空望远镜的“幽灵粒子”荣获诺贝尔物理学奖
items.desc_en: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.
items.desc_zh: 比利时物理学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑教授因其在探测太空粒子的天文台方面的开创性工作而获奖。

items.title_en: Italian PM files to trademark her voice against AI threats
items.title_zh: 意大利总理申请将她的声音注册商标以应对人工智能威胁
items.desc_en: Giorgia Meloni submitted a four-second audio to a EU agency in a bid to protect her voice from deepfakes.
items.desc_zh: 乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 向欧盟机构提交了一段四秒的音频，以保护她的声音免受深度伪造。

items.title_en: ASOS app users receive push notifications apparently sent by hackers
items.title_zh: ASOS 应用程序用户收到显然是黑客发送的推送通知
items.desc_en: Dozens of people appear to have received a strange message from the clothing and beauty store's app.
items.desc_zh: 数十人似乎从服装和美容商店的应用程序中收到了一条奇怪的消息。

items.title_en: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.title_zh: 德国前间谍头子因间谍和叛国罪被捕
items.desc_en: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.
items.desc_zh: 奥古斯特·汉宁被指控为外国势力获取机密信息。

items.title_en: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
items.title_zh: 印度反对派议员因抗议选举主席而被拘留
items.desc_en: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.
items.desc_zh: 反对派领导人指控 CEC Gyanesh Kumar 在选举期间操纵选民名册以支持总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的政党。

items.title_en: Student riots engulf France as far-right presidential frontrunner Le Pen vows fiscal turnaround
items.title_zh: 法国极右翼总统候选人勒庞誓言扭转财政局面，学生骚乱席卷法国
items.desc_en: A teenager reportedly lost a hand in the protests, which have seen over 5,000 people arrested.
items.desc_zh: 据报道，一名青少年在抗议活动中失去了一只手，抗议活动已导致 5000 多人被捕。

items.title_en: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
items.title_zh: 随着疫情蔓延，肯尼亚确认首例埃博拉死亡病例
items.desc_en: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.
items.desc_zh: 该患者曾居住在刚果民主共和国，该国今年已有 4000 多人死于该病。

items.title_en: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature
items.title_zh: Ofcom 调查 Instagram Instants 功能上的 Meta
items.desc_en: The regulator said Instagram had not fully assessed risks posed by its Instants feature prior to launching it.
items.desc_zh: 监管机构表示，Instagram 在推出 Instants 功能之前并未对其所带来的风险进行全面评估。

items.title_en: Lego fraudster among last year's most high-profile insurance scammers
items.title_zh: 乐高诈骗者跻身去年最引人注目的保险诈骗者之列
items.desc_en: The person was sentenced to 28 months in prison after an investigation found the claims were made up, the insurance trade body, the ABI said.
items.desc_zh: ABI 表示，保险行业机构调查发现这些索赔都是捏造的，此人被判处 28 个月监禁。

items.title_en: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools months after blacklisting company, BBC told
items.title_zh: BBC 称，五角大楼在将公司列入黑名单几个月后停止使用 Anthropic 人工智能工具
items.desc_en: It labelled the company a "supply chain risk" earlier this year, but multiple sources said Anthropic's Claude model was recently widely used.
items.desc_zh: 今年早些时候，该公司将该公司标记为“供应链风险”，但多位消息人士称，Anthropic 的克劳德模型最近被广泛使用。

items.title_en: Yemeni government forces say they have 'secured' Bab al-Mandab Strait
items.title_zh: 也门政府军称他们已“保卫”曼德海峡
items.desc_en: Houthi-run media deny the government has made advances in the Dhubab area, which overlooks the strategic Red Sea waterway.
items.desc_zh: 胡塞武装媒体否认政府在杜巴布地区取得进展，该地区俯瞰着红海战略航道。

items.desc_zh: 这些前雇员因与外部人工智能评估小组共享数据而受到调查。

items.title_en: Crypto thieves attack man in home and threaten to kill pregnant wife's baby in 'horrific' robbery
items.title_zh: 加密货币窃贼袭击家中男子，并威胁要杀死怀孕妻子的孩子，这是一场“可怕”的抢劫
items.desc_en: The man was beaten with hammers until he transferred hundreds of thousands of pounds of cryptocurrency.
items.desc_zh: 该男子被用锤子殴打，直到他转移了数十万英镑的加密货币。

items.desc_zh: 总统希望人工智能被称为超级智能（SI），与斯洛文尼亚域名使用的缩写相同。

items.desc_en: Andrew Bailey says the central bank is watching the waves of cash being invested in artificial intelligence "very carefully".
items.desc_zh: 安德鲁·贝利表示，央行正在“非常仔细地”关注投资人工智能的资金浪潮。
